content: Individuals diagnosed with type 1 diabetes are at an elevated risk of developing autoimmune conditions, including thyroid disorders. Therefore, it is recommended that routine screening for thyroid dysfunction be conducted in this population. Patients with type 1 diabetes are also more likely to experience vitamin B12 deficiency and autoimmune diseases such as Addison’s disease, necessitating vigilance for these conditions. For individuals presenting with symptoms indicative of celiac disease, such as gastrointestinal disturbances, unexplained laboratory abnormalities, or clinical suspicion based on other findings, screening for celiac disease is strongly advised.
